newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia wool indicator falls 11c to 594c/kg.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia wool indicator falls 11c to 594c/kg.

text.p: The Australian wool market eastern indicator dropped 11 cents to 594 cents a kg clean on Wednesday at sales in Sydney and Adelaide, Wool International (WI) said.
Apart from fine 19 micron merino fleece which rose 0.5 percent, all merino fleece lost ground with falls ranging from up to 1.0 percent for 20/26m to 2.5 percent for 21/22/23/24m.
Merino skirtings of 19m were slightly dearer and 20/21m were 1.0 percent cheaper.
In crossbreds, 27/28m were 1.0 percent cheaper, 29m 0.5 percent cheaper, 30m 2.0 percent cheaper and 31m 1.5 percent cheaper.
In cardings, lambs were slightly cheaper and locks and crutchings up to 1.0 percent cheaper, WI said.
WI said Japan and China were the principal buyers with strong support from local mills.
Of the 37,661 bales offered, 11.9 percent were passed in.
Sales continue on Thursday in Sydney and Adelaide with about 33,000 bales to be offered.
